---
title: "Squad: Sprint Retrospective"
description: "Post-sprint analysis: velocity, blockers, quality metrics, action items for next sprint"
mode: "squad-tech-manager"
input: "Sprint number, sprint end date, team feedback"
---

Conduct sprint retrospective:

1. **Gather Metrics** (Pre-meeting) — Velocity (committed vs completed, efficiency %). Quality (coverage %, code review time, build pass rate, post-deploy defects). Blockers (impact, duration, resolution). Team health (morale, capacity, unplanned work).
2. **Team Discussion** (90 min) — What went well? (15 min) What could improve? (15 min) What will we try next sprint? (15 min). Identify patterns and action items.
3. **Create Action Items** — Assign owners, set priorities (high/medium/low), estimate effort, commit to next sprint.
4. **Document** — Publish to Confluence: summary, key metrics table, blockers resolved, action items for Sprint N+1, next steps.
5. **Share with Leadership** — Email/Slack: efficiency rate, wins, areas for improvement, next sprint forecast.

Deliver: Retrospective document (Confluence) + action items (Jira) + team notified.
